verdict.rationale: Sandbox0's core product is an isolated cloud computer where an AI agent can run code, install software and manage files (sandbox0-docs-1). Network policies restrict outbound traffic so the sandbox can be kept off production systems (sandbox0-docs-13), and credential features avoid placing raw secrets inside the sandbox (sandbox0-docs-15). Snapshots, rollback and forking let agents test against disposable copies of a known state (sandbox0-docs-8, sandbox0-docs-9). Missing for 10: an explicit documented statement on separating sandbox data from production data, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the isolation guarantees.
